goblin.name: Goblin
traits: Nimble Escape: can Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.
Darkvision 60 ft.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.text: A wicked curved blade.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.text: Fires from cover.

goblin.tactics: cowardly opportunist: shoots from cover, ganks the wounded, and runs when the boss falls

goblin-boss.name: Goblin Boss
traits: Nimble Escape: can Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.
Multiattack: makes two scimitar attacks.
Darkvision 60 ft.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.text: Two swift cuts (Multiattack).

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text: Hurled when out of reach.

goblin-boss.tactics: brags before he bleeds; drives the goblins forward, then bolts to warn the warren once bloodied
goblin-boss.epithet: Snaggletooth. He brags before he bleeds.

wolf.name: Wolf
traits: Pack Tactics: advantage on attacks against a creature if an ally is within 5 ft of it.
Keen Hearing and Smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Lunges for the legs; a hit may knock the target prone (DC 11 STR).

wolf.tactics: hunts in a pack, flanks with the goblins, and pulls down the isolated

lantern-cultist.name: Lantern Cultist
traits: Fanatical Resolve: holds position while a named leader remains standing.

actions.name: Hooked Knife
actions.text: A ritual blade meant to catch cloaks and straps.

actions.name: Lead Sling
actions.text: A stone loosed from behind cover.

lantern-cultist.tactics: surrounds isolated heroes and protects the ritual leader
lantern-cultist.epithet: Their lamps burn with no visible oil.

tidebound.name: Tidebound
traits: Amphibious: breathes air and water.
Salt-Slick Hide: ignores wet difficult terrain.

actions.name: Brine Claw
actions.text: A barnacled hand lashes through the spray.

tidebound.tactics: emerges from water, divides the party, and drags the wounded toward the tide

starved-husk.name: Starved Husk
traits: Unblinking: cannot be surprised while beneath open sky.

actions.name: Cold Grasp
actions.text: Fingers rimed with impossible starlight close around living warmth.

starved-husk.tactics: moves beneath sight lines and converges on the brightest spellcaster

ash-raider.name: Ash Raider
traits: Mountain Born: ignores scree difficult terrain.

actions.name: Bearded Axe
actions.text: A heavy hooked axe strikes around shields.

actions.name: Black Javelin
actions.text: A soot-dark spear arcs over the stones.

ash-raider.tactics: holds narrow ground, pins the front line, and contests the beacon
ash-raider.epithet: They mean to put out the last light.

black-plume.name: Black-Plume Agent
traits: Cunning Footwork: seeks cover after a ranged attack.

actions.name: Dueling Blade
actions.text: A courtly fencing form stripped of every courtesy.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.text: A compact bow hidden beneath tournament colors.

black-plume.tactics: uses cover, targets witnesses, and retreats toward prepared exits
black-plume.epithet: The court smiles while the knife is drawn.

orc-raider.name: Orc Raider
traits: Aggressive: charges straight into melee to break ranged formations.
Darkvision 60 ft.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.text: A brutal two-handed iron cleaver.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text: Hurled while closing the gap.

orc-raider.tactics: rushes the nearest frontline fighter and pressures casters if left unchecked

ogre-brute.name: Ogre Brute
traits: Darkvision 60 ft.
Siege Bulk: anchors choke points and shrugs off glancing blows.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.text: An iron-banded timber swung like a falling beam.

actions.name: Heavy Javelin
actions.text: A spear the size of a fence post.

ogre-brute.tactics: blocks bridges and doors, swinging at whoever dares step in reach
ogre-brute.epithet: The bridge groans under every step.

cult-fanatic.name: Cult Fanatic
traits: Dark Devotion: steely resolve against fear and charm.
Spellcasting: channels 1st- and 2nd-level dark prayers.

actions.name: Inflict Wounds
actions.text: A blackened palm delivers searing necrotic chill.

actions.name: Hold Person
actions.text: Concentration. Locks a foe in place on a failed WIS save.

actions.name: Ceremonial Dagger
actions.text: Two swift ritual slashes (Multiattack).

cult-fanatic.tactics: stands behind bruisers, pins heroes with Hold Person, and punishes melee rushers with Inflict Wounds
cult-fanatic.epithet: Cinder prayers whispered through clenched teeth.

hobgoblin-captain.name: Hobgoblin Captain
traits: Martial Advantage: lethal coordination beside allies.
Leadership: steadies nearby soldiers.
Multiattack: two greatsword strikes.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text: Two disciplined heavy-blade strikes (Multiattack).

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text: Thrown with legion precision.

hobgoblin-captain.tactics: holds formation beside allies and focuses fire on high-value targets
hobgoblin-captain.epithet: Steel drilled until mercy falls away.

owlbear.name: Owlbear
traits: Keen Sight and Smell.
Multiattack: tears in with beak and claws.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Twin raking swipes (Multiattack).

actions.name: Beak
actions.text: A snapping hooked beak.

owlbear.tactics: charges the loudest intruder and mauls relentlessly until driven back or felled
owlbear.epithet: Feathers matted with vault dust and fury.

wight-commander.name: Wight Commander
traits: Darkvision 60 ft.
Sunlight Sensitivity.
Multiattack: makes two weapon strikes or a life drain.

actions.name: Grave Longsword
actions.text: Two frost-rimmed cuts (Multiattack).

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.text: Cold necrotic grasp drains living vitality.

actions.name: Grave Longbow
actions.text: Fires tarnished arrows down the corridor.

wight-commander.tactics: holds ancient defensive lines, fires from cover, and duels anyone crossing the threshold
wight-commander.epithet: An oath that outlived the flesh that swore it.

ashen-warden.name: Ashen Warden
traits: Emberplate Armor (AC 16).
Multiattack: two cinder greatsword swings.
Sanctum Flame: commands fiery sphere bursts.

actions.name: Cinder Greatsword
actions.text: Two white-hot sweeps of forged citadel steel (Multiattack).

actions.name: Cinder Burst
actions.text: 15-ft sphere of citadel fire; 4d6 fire damage, DEX save for half.

actions.name: Ember Lance
actions.text: A spear of molten cinder hurled across the sanctum.

ashen-warden.tactics: commands the sanctum from the hearth, punishes clustered heroes with Cinder Burst, and meets challengers blade-to-blade
ashen-warden.epithet: If the valley will not remember its oath, the ash will.
